t.why: An EU and NATO member on the Black Sea that adopted the euro in 2026.
t.rel: It borders Turkey, an important neighbor for migration and trade. It has clashed with North Macedonia over language and the interpretation of history, once blocking that country's EU accession talks. With Romania and Greece it builds shared transport and energy links within the EU.
t.know: It is considered the place where the Cyrillic alphabet was created.
t.etext: With wages on the low side for the EU, car-parts and electronic-parts factories are moving in. It started using the euro in 2026. Black Sea tourism and IT outsourcing are growing too.
